reviews_verbatim.author: Nicole Conde
reviews_verbatim.text: I cannot recommend this salon enough! I went in for a trim and a keratin treatment, and from the moment I walked through the door, Nancy made me feel so welcome. She is incredibly friendly, genuine, and made the entire experience feel comfortable and personal. The salon has such a warm, homey atmosphere that you immediately feel at ease.

reviews_verbatim.author: Tatiana Daguillard
reviews_verbatim.text: I truly love this business and encourage everyone to patronize it. I moved to Miami at the end of 2024, and since then I've been going to Unique every month. Kim is absolutely the best, she's been my nail tech for over a year now. ... I also love the homey feel of the salon, it reminds me of a classic '90s beauty salon in the best way. It's family owned, welcoming, and consistent.

reviews_verbatim.author: Todd Doster
reviews_verbatim.text: Very professional salon with talented stylists and a friendly atmosphere. My haircut was done with care and turned out exactly as I wanted. The salon was clean and well-maintained, and the service was efficient and satisfying.

reviews_verbatim.author: Nikki
reviews_verbatim.text: Absolutely phenomenal work. I wanted a butterfly haircut with long layers and she did exactly that. I can't think of a better haircut for me. May God bless salon with many more clients!!

reviews_verbatim.author: Eli
reviews_verbatim.text: Me atiendo con Kim para mis uñas y me encantan, siempre me duran mucho, y es detallista, y el cabello tengo años cortándolo con Nancy. Y siempre quedo contenta.

reviews_verbatim.author: Lynda Ulrich
reviews_verbatim.text: My husband and I just had the best experience here. Lovely people! The owner is so nice, professional and her expertise is obvious. And Millie, helped us both with the best pedicures we've ever had.

reviews_verbatim.author: Megan Holmes
reviews_verbatim.text: Super great experience here! The girls were so kind & fun to chat with while Kimberly did my nails. She helped me get a perfect color match with a dress I'm wearing to an event, and she was very skilled.

reviews_verbatim.author: Tatiana Cancel
reviews_verbatim.text: I went in there desperate for help on my hair and Kim was so so sweet. And her mom and sister as well! Her mom Nancy cut my hair and Kim styled it perfectly I walked out feeling lil a whole different woman.

reviews_verbatim.author: Isa A
reviews_verbatim.text: Nancy, the owner, is amazing. She's the only hairstylist who has ever gotten my color right. I highly recommend her.

brand_vibe: Real logo is a black-and-white minimalist floral emblem with a script 'u' monogram (found on Setmore + staff t-shirts). Reviews repeatedly describe the salon as 'bright and spacious', 'warm, homey atmosphere', 'clean and well-maintained', 'classic 90s beauty salon feel', 'family owned'. Chose a light, warm base (light-v2 skeleton) with a terracotta-rosewood accent palette to match that inviting, daylight, family-salon character rather than a moody dark-luxury look.

images.gallery_adaptation: Could not obtain any real interior/service-result photos: Instagram (no confirmed handle for this exact location), Facebook (blocks all unauthenticated scraping), Yelp (DataDome bot protection, 403 on every attempt including raw curl with browser UA), and Google Maps (no JS-capable browser available in this environment, no Places API key) were all inaccessible. No .venv-pw/Playwright available locally either. Per pipeline rule against using portraits as 'results' gallery tiles, the standard photo-gallery section was ADAPTED into a 'Meet the team' section using the 4 real staff photos with name+role captions (tile-cap), instead of fabricating or mislabeling any stock/unrelated imagery. This is a deliberate, documented adaptation, not a shortcut: zero fabricated or misattributed images are used anywhere on the site.
